g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 9 schedule rows of docs-authority/nozzles/H2_DRYER.csv at tag, face and bore

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N1 (process H2 in) on -Y at z 160; N2 (process H2 out), N5 (H2 relief contingency, S24), N6 (H2 normal path, S64), N7 (dried hydrogen - product gas edge, drawn DN15 bore not calculated per plan W4), N8 (sweep air) and N9 (TSA regeneration condensate) on +Y at z 600

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N3 drain flush at the envelope bottom (50 datum); N4 vent flush at the envelope top - the vent is S24 to RELIEF_H2 (duty section 6), destination named; the 800 datum is a placeholder under the 1028 box
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: Atmospheric open-bore tube stubs per duty section 4 (no flange class); the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text
